Title: Egress to cloud instance-metadata endpoint (IMDS)
Detail: Workload "prod/malware" connected to metadata endpoint 169.254.169.254 3 time(s). This endpoint vends node/instance IAM credentials; container access to it is a common credential-theft and privilege-escalation path.

Title: Periodic C2 beaconing pattern to external host
Detail: 6 connections to cdn.evil-c2.example at a near-constant 60s interval (jitter CV 0.000), averaging 512 bytes each — the low-jitter, low-volume signature of an automated callback.

Title: Probable DGA activity (NXDOMAIN storm to high-entropy domains)
Detail: 12 NXDOMAIN responses across 12 distinct parent domains with avg leftmost-label entropy 3.84 bits/char — the pattern of a domain-generation algorithm probing for its live C2 rendezvous.

Title: Probable DNS tunnelling (high-entropy subdomain queries)
Detail: 25 queries under "tunnel.example" with avg subdomain entropy 3.94 bits/char and avg length 24 (max 24); 25 used data-carrying record types. Long, high-entropy labels under one parent are the signature of DNS tunnelling.

Title: High-volume upload to external host (possible data exfiltration)
Detail: Workload "prod/malware" sent 60.0 MiB to drop.exfil-store.example across 1 connection(s) with a 15360.0:1 upload:download ratio — an upload-dominant transfer to a single external destination.

Title: Lateral-movement fan-out across internal peers
Detail: Workload "prod/scanner" connected to 12 distinct internal peers across 12 distinct port(s) — a fan-out consistent with east-west scanning or lateral movement rather than a fixed dependency set.

Title: Workload runs with host network namespace
Detail: hostNetwork removes network-namespace isolation; NetworkPolicy/egress rules do not apply to this pod.

Title: Egress denied by policy (blocked-egress alert)
Detail: 5 egress attempt(s) from "prod/blocked-app" to blocked.example were dropped by policy. Repeated denials can indicate a misconfigured allowlist or a workload probing for an exit.
